# Bhrayan Márquez — AI Automation Engineer

I build automation systems that connect business tools, APIs, AI and CRM: lead capture
and qualification, CRM synchronization, WhatsApp and voice agents, and n8n workflows
designed with retries, deduplication and persistent error handling.

Everything in this portfolio is backed by evidence: end-to-end verified flows, 113
passing automated tests and CI in GitHub Actions.

## How we work

1. Discovery call — understand the real process.
2. Architecture document — what gets automated, what stays human.
3. Phased build — happy path first, hardening second.
4. Delivery with documentation — diagrams, decisions, rollback.
5. Operation and tuning — measured and corrected with real data.
